2. The brief facts of the case of the appellants/claimants  follows:
 On 18.10.2020 at about 7.00 hours while the first responde  riding the Motor Cycle bearing Registration No.AP-26-BR-0188 at  Kartampadu village from Nellore to Kadapa near Nellore, Andhra Prade  a lorry bearing Registration No.AP-39-TA-6579 belonging to the secon  respondent driven by its driver in a very rash and negligent manner
dashed against the first respondent.
Hence, the first respondent fil  claim petition before the Tribunal seeking compensation at 35,00,000

Hence prays to allow  this appeal.

 therefore, it need not be interfered.
